name: OC Electric
tagline: Wired Right. Every Time. Ask Joe.
brandNarrative:
OC Electric isn't your typical electrical contractor — it's a tight-knit operation built around one electrician who customers can't stop talking about by name. Joe has earned a perfect five-star rating across every single review, not by luck, but by showing up clean, thorough, and ready to adapt. When Ruth Ann Albro's kitchen renovation took an unexpected turn mid-project, Joe didn't flinch — he accommodated the changes and then followed up with work at her mom's house, tackling everything from loose outlets to breaker replacements with the same care. That's the OC Electric way: residential or commercial, big job or small, the standard doesn't drop.

The scope of work OC Electric handles is wider than most expect. Kevin Fish trusted Joe with both his home and his warehouse — installing an EV charging unit, a 50-amp RV hookup, and then three separate 50-amp industrial connections to power complex machinery. James Wohlmacher got a complete bathroom remodel electrical package: new outlets, light fixtures, and recessed lighting, all exactly as envisioned. Ben Boyer called Joe in a pinch and came away converted. Nicky Bruce, who has worked alongside electricians for over 30 years, called Joe the most knowledgeable and nicest she has ever encountered. That's not a small claim.

What ties every review together is a consistent emotional thread: customers feel safe, heard, and genuinely taken care of. Joe doesn't upsell confusion — he gives thorough bids, explains the work, and executes precisely. The photos from OC Electric's portfolio back it up: service panel installations mid-construction, new-build framing wired with care, luxury kitchen and commercial storefront finishes that speak to serious range. Oregon City has found its electrician.
ownerStory:
Joe is the kind of tradesperson who earns a first-name basis with every client by the end of the first job. Based out of Oregon City, Oregon, he founded OC Electric with a straightforward philosophy: do the work right, be easy to work with, and never cut corners on safety. Customers don't just recommend him — they describe him in terms usually reserved for trusted friends: reliable, clean, thorough, knowledgeable, and genuinely kind. Nicky Bruce, a construction industry veteran with three decades of experience, put it plainly: Joe is the best she's ever worked with. That kind of endorsement doesn't come from marketing. It comes from showing up at 7 AM with the right tools, the right plan, and the right attitude — every single day of the week.

Joe's work spans the full spectrum of electrical contracting — from helping an elderly woman with a loose outlet at home, to engineering three 50-amp industrial connections for warehouse machinery. He treats every job with the same precision, whether it's a bathroom remodel in a residential neighborhood or a new commercial build with framing and panel work happening simultaneously. He operates seven days a week, from 7 AM to 6 PM, because he understands that his clients' timelines matter. OC Electric is Joe — and Joe is exactly the kind of electrician you want on your job site.

stats.label: Available Every Day of the Week

faq.question: Does OC Electric handle both residential and commercial work?
faq.answer: Yes — Joe regularly works across both. He has installed EV chargers and done kitchen and bathroom remodel wiring for homeowners, while also wiring warehouses with complex industrial 50-amp machinery connections. No job is too small or too specialized.

faq.question: What if my project changes scope partway through?
faq.answer: Not a problem. Multiple customers, including Ruth Ann Albro during her kitchen renovation, have changed plans mid-project and found Joe easy to accommodate. Flexibility is part of how OC Electric operates.

faq.question: How quickly can OC Electric respond to an urgent electrical need?
faq.answer: Joe has stepped in on short notice for customers in a pinch and delivered fast, professional results. OC Electric is available seven days a week from 7 AM to 6 PM, making scheduling straightforward even on weekends.

faq.question: What does the bidding process look like?
faq.answer: Customers consistently describe OC Electric's bids as thorough and timely. James Wohlmacher noted that the estimate for his bathroom remodel covered everything clearly, with no surprises — and the final result matched exactly what was discussed.

faq.question: Is OC Electric safe and up to code?
faq.answer: Safety is a consistent theme in customer reviews. Ruth Ann Albro specifically noted that work at her mother's home was 'great and more importantly, safe.' Every installation — from breaker replacements to industrial wiring — is done by a highly trained electrician.

faq.question: Can OC Electric install an EV charger or RV hookup at my home?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Kevin Fish had both a Level 2 EV charging unit and a 50-amp RV hookup installed at his residence, and described the work as clean, safe, and professional. Call (503) 801-9038 to schedule an assessment.
